scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Parivar Suraksha Yojana (DAYALU)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Haryana
Beneficiary must possess a Family ID/Parivar Pehchaan Patra (PPP) number
Beneficiary must be the family member with disability or an eligible relative in case of death
Family income must be verified in the Family Information Data Repository (FIDR) database
Applicants must be registered under Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB) or Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCW)
Claims for deaths or disabilities occurring before 1 April 2023 are not entertained
In case of death, assistance is paid to the head of the family or the eldest eligible family member as per age rules
If all family members are minors, assistance is released after any member turns 18
If a minor girl child is present and the beneficiary is aged 25‑45, half of the compensation (₹2.5 lakh) is paid to the girl’s Aadhaar‑linked bank account
benefits_summary: One‑time financial assistance ranging from ₹1 lakh to ₹5 lakh depending on the beneficiary’s age.
